setup: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS probe_a (k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT, n INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS probe_b (k TEXT, v TEXT)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS probe_b_k ON probe_b (k)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS probe_log (k TEXT, at INTEGER)
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS probe_tr AFTER INSERT ON probe_a BEGIN INSERT INTO probe_log VALUES (new.k, 1); END
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS probe_v AS SELECT k, v FROM probe_b
statements: SELECT v FROM probe_a WHERE k = ?1

SELECT a.k, b.v FROM probe_a a JOIN probe_b b ON b.k = a.k WHERE a.n > ?1
SELECT a.k, b.v FROM probe_a a LEFT JOIN probe_b b ON b.v = a.v
SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(n) AS s, MAX(n) AS m FROM probe_a GROUP BY k HAVING c > 1 ORDER BY 2
SELECT * FROM probe_a WHERE k IN (SELECT k FROM probe_b)
SELECT * FROM probe_a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM probe_b WHERE probe_b.k = probe_a.k)
WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM probe_b) SELECT * FROM x
WITH RECURSIVE c(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM c WHERE i < 5) SELECT i FROM c
SELECT k FROM probe_a UNION SELECT k FROM probe_b

SELECT k, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY n) FROM probe_a
SELECT json_extract(v, '$.a'), CAST(n AS TEXT), substr(k, 1, 2), coalesce(v, ''), n / CAST(?1 AS INTEGER) FROM probe_a
SELECT * FROM probe_a WHERE k LIKE 'a%' AND n BETWEEN 1 AND 5 OR v IS NULL

INSERT INTO probe_b (k, v) VALUES (?1, ?2) RETURNING k, v
